name: com.field-viewer/field-viewer
title: Field-Viewer
description: Open IFC models and drawings in the workshop and on site. Create projects and publish versions.

tools.name: fv_get_sample_scene
tools.description: Opens one of Field-Viewer's three synthetic sample models (e.g. woning_lindehof) read-only: signed 3D artefact URLs valid for 24 h, plus its name and audience. Use listSamples for the slugs. Public, no side effects.

slug.description: The sample to open, e.g. `woning_lindehof` (as `listSamples` returns it).

locale.description: The language of `name` and `audience` (nl, en or fr); the request's Accept-Language, else Dutch, when omitted.

tools.name: fv_get_service_status
tools.description: Reports whether the Field-Viewer API is reachable and which build is serving traffic. Use it as a first, unauthenticated call to confirm the API is up, or to read the current buildId for support and debugging. Do not use it to check a specific resource's health or as a substitute for authentication. Takes no arguments. Returns status (always "ok" when this call succeeds), buildId (the deployed build identifier) and reportedAt (RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of this check). Read-only, no side effects; callable by anyone without credentials (capability: public). Also callable by an anonymous try-it session (anonymousAccess).

tools.name: fv_list_plans
tools.description: Lists Field-Viewer's plans (free, team, enterprise) with their limits, features and the Team price (EUR cents, excl. VAT, monthly and yearly), the Team trial length (trial.days, no card) and grace days after a failed payment (graceDays): what each plan allows and costs, whether it takes DXF/DWG drawings (features.cadDrawings) and how long its content is kept (limits.retentionDays, null: no expiry), and so what an upgrade adds when a limit is reached (entitlement.limit_reached) or a feature is not included (entitlement.feature_unavailable). With organizationId (owner/admin): that organisation's own price. Public, no side effects.

includeInternal.description: `true` also returns the plans that are not offered publicly (`internal`, `tryout`). Platform admins only.

includeTryout.description: `true` also returns the `tryout` row (the limits of a tryout without an account), as the try page reads its size cap. Open to anyone.

organizationId.description: Returns this organisation's own price (its discount applied) instead of the list price. Owners and admins of the organisation only.

tools.name: fv_list_samples
tools.description: Lists Field-Viewer's sample models (slug, name, audience line, card image) that getSampleScene opens. Public, no side effects.

locale.description: The language of `name` and `audience` (nl, en or fr); the request's Accept-Language, else Dutch, when omitted.
